gbm_population_evidence.quote: Grade 3 or 4 IDH1/2 mutant astrocytoma (2021 WHO classification)

candidate_evidence.quote: The focus of this project is the development of a radiation sensitizer (a small molecule ATM inhibitor, WSD0628) with the goal to enhance the efficacy of radiation therapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Disease progression after previous treatment for glioma with radiation and chemotherapy
ATM-Inhibitor WSD0628 in Combination With Radiation Therapy for Treatment of Recurrent High-Grade Glioma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: an additional 6 patients will have a tissue evaluation of tumor penetrance after a one-time dose of study drug prior to radiosurgery and surgical resection (Phase 0, tumor penetrance cohort)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Additionally, PK, pharmacodynamic (PD), overall survival, progression-free survival, overall response rate, and patient-reported outcomes will be evaluated.
Evaluate biologic activity measures using rank-based desirability scores (RDS) generated for each of the dose levels

role_evidence.quote: A non-toxic compound and inhibits the DNA damage response associated with radiation therapy.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: ATM inhibition / DNA damage response inhibition radiosensitizing glioma cells

source_quote.quote: Grade 3 or 4 IDH1/2 mutant astrocytoma (2021 WHO classification)

coder_notes: Eligible histologies are IDH-wildtype glioblastoma or IDH-mutant grade 3/4 astrocytoma; IDH status defines the diagnosis rather than restricting entry to one IDH group, so IDH row is diagnostic, not candidate-matched. Group C randomizes 1:1 between two WSD0628 dose levels; no control arm. Target engagement coded yes on a stated PD evaluation and mandatory tissue for correlative research; the PD sample type and marker (e.g. ATM inhibition) are not specified in the registered outcomes. Phase registered as PHASE1 though title says Phase 0/I.
